name: Solutionwhere statics
source: Base layout is the approved P1-A1 static (80% less time on registration admin). Offer copy comes from clients/solutionwhere/creative/matrix.json angles A1–A5, one set per CAMP 01 ad set.
layout: One short offer line under the logo: the product and the result, about eight to twelve words
A browser frame below the offer showing the real module screenshot
One button under the screenshot that reads exactly: Book a demo
Small decorative dots only. No icon row, no second window, no extra caption
logo: clients/fb/assets/reference_image/product_images/logo-solutionwhere.png — blue center dot, orange and blue ring dots, solution in orange, where in blue. Do not redraw it.

modes.dark: Navy background #152033, white headline. This is the approved base.
modes.light: Warm off-white background #F6F3EE, navy headline #1B3048. Same composition.

whatWins: The image carries the product and the result in one line, plus a Book a demo button. Headline, primary text, and description travel with the ad and are not stacked on the picture.
The product screenshot is the proof. Keep the real UI. Do not invent dashboards.
High contrast. Dark or light, never a muddy middle.
No URL, no phone number, no file names, no people, no children, no stock photos.
forbidden: WISDOMWHERE or any invented product name
A second window, Finder, desktop, or filenames
A different logo than the dotted mark
